title: Squadrons Database Schema
description: Schema for squadron data mapping squadron IDs to names and aircraft

aircraft.description: Aircraft type flown by this squadron (e.g., 'F-16C_50', 'A-10C_2')

training.description: Gun ammo type for training missions (must match airframe's ammoTypes)

combat.description: Gun ammo type for combat missions (must match airframe's ammoTypes)

defaultGunAmmo.description: Default gun ammo types for training and combat missions

exportFormat.description: MDC export format for this squadron. Squadrons without this property do not support MDC export.
